aspects.name: Scoring Volume & Tempo
aspects.description: Filter wides, evaluate true boundary % vs strike rotation.

aspects.name: Dot-Ball Pressure & Stagnation
aspects.description: Dot-ball creation for bowlers; dot-avoidance for batsmen.

aspects.name: Wicket Attribution & True Survival
aspects.description: Clean separation of bowler-credited wickets from run-outs and retirements.

aspects.name: Discipline & Extra Penalty
aspects.description: Penalty weighting for death-over unforced wides/no-balls.

aspects.name: Partnership Support & Breaking
aspects.description: Crease survival when partner accelerates; 40+ run stand breaker.

aspects.name: Handedness & Angle Matchups
aspects.description: Efficiency vs opposite-handed and spin matchups (e.g. SLA vs LHB).

aspects.name: Pace vs. Spin Mastery
aspects.description: Harmonic mean between pace & spin efficiency to penalize one-dimensional play.

aspects.name: Speed & Express Pace Handling
aspects.description: Express pace (>=140 km/h) RAE and speed variance control.

aspects.name: Delivery Style Variation
aspects.description: Out-of-fold Expected Runs (xR) and Expected Wickets (xW) target-encoding.

aspects.name: Line & Trajectory Control
aspects.description: Trajectorial off-stump vs leg-stump containment and angles.

aspects.name: Shot Selection & False-Shot Rate
aspects.description: Categorical clustering into attacking, controlled, and false strokes.

aspects.name: Innings Phase Segmentation
aspects.description: Powerplay (1-6), Middle (7-15), and Death (16-20) normalized baselines.

aspects.name: Win Probability Added (WPA)
aspects.description: XGBoost in-game win probability delta per delivery (WP_t - WP_t-1).

aspects.name: Collapse Recovery & Post-Wicket Shock
aspects.description: Stabilization when entering at >= 2 wickets down in Powerplay.

aspects.name: Knockout Stage Multiplier (1.75x)
aspects.description: Amplified leverage for Finals, Qualifiers, and Eliminators.

aspects.name: Match-Winning Impact & POTM
aspects.description: Isolating positive performance strictly in winning team contributions.

aspects.name: Venue Scoring Baseline (xR / xW)
aspects.description: True strike rate and economy relative to ground dimensions and historical par.

aspects.name: Home vs. Away Resilience (1.40x)
aspects.description: Evaluating foreign/away conditions vs comfortable home ground baselines.

aspects.name: Toss Disadvantage & Dew Factor (1.30x)
aspects.description: Night dew second innings defense after losing the coin toss.

aspects.name: 3-Dot Chokehold Escape & Wicket Conversion
aspects.description: Boundary/escape release vs 4th-ball wicket induction after 3 consecutive dots.

aspects.name: Post-Boundary Bounce-Back Composure
aspects.description: Dot ball or wicket rate on the delivery immediately following a 4 or 6.

aspects.name: Tail-Ender Strike Farming
aspects.description: Boundary hunting on balls 1-4 and single rotation on balls 5-6 when partner >= 8.

aspects.name: 6th-Ball Over-Closing Resilience
aspects.description: Execution on final ball of over to protect economy and prevent momentum shift.

aspects.name: Empirical Bayes Shrinkage (k=50)
aspects.description: Shrinks small sample outliers toward prior mean (sh = sum / (n + 50)) to eliminate fluke spikes.

aspects.name: Winsorized Z-Score Normalization
aspects.description: Capping standardized scores at +/- 3 sigma before composite index aggregation.

aspects.name: Zero-Leakage Out-Of-Fold Validation
aspects.description: Ensures ML models predict on unseen matches only, preventing lookahead bias.
